pages.title: Memory Cell
pages.text: A lymphocyte that has met an invader once and never forgets it: years later it wakes and answers in hours. Dropped by T Cells and kept in the Germinal Centres of Inner Space's Lymph Node; the Antibody Bench raises more from lymph tissue.
